provenance: New synthetic contextual challenges; original v1 retained. No production user data.

cases.casual_preserves_existing: Answer the small writing request in chat; do not turn it into a durable action or disturb the unrelated pending review.
cases.delegated_ready_real_path: The real work-style normal-chat prompt should publish the completed Orbit review, retain the original form and record waiting through its own work. Do not mark Cedar ready or submit without review.
cases.return_mixed_states: Reconcile the existing Orbit item from obsolete missing-date to prepared review, remove submitted Pine, do not label running Cedar ready or invent a new approval stage.
cases.selected_reply_routes_work: Interpret the short date using the exact selected card, route user message 602 to Cedar work, retire/supersede the now-answered visible question and resolve its form. Do not treat the date as submission approval or persist it as a general preference.
cases.return_empty_no_busywork: Respect the pause, keep the list empty and do not manufacture work or reopen a conversation unnecessarily.
cases.curate_ten_on_return: Prioritize the one review the user actually requested, curate/aggregate/displace low-value optional items to keep at most 10, preserve still-useful underlying saved opportunities. No invented deadlines or submission approval.
